title.value: Plan and price a full trip through a booking CLI

introduction.value: An AI agent with no prior knowledge of the tooling planned and priced a Dulles–Barcelona round trip with seven hotel nights in under three minutes, verified bookable by dry run (vendor demo).

method.value: A fresh agent session got one instruction: plan and price a real trip with Voyagier's CLI. It read the tool's built-in docs, created one traveler with a passport and loyalty numbers, searched live flights and hotels, and chose a United nonstop and Le Méridien Barcelona. Each response listed remaining blockers and the next command. It finished with a dry-run booking check.

outcome.value: The cold agent reached a verified $3,931.21 quote in 26 commands and just under seven minutes. An agent that already knew the tool took 17 commands and 161 seconds. It still hit minor friction, such as a warning line that corrupted JSON output.

notes.value: Access is by invitation, and the real booking step spends money. Search, plan, quote and dry-run cost nothing, and the booking command refuses to run without a stated expected total.

source_text.body:
Plan and price a full trip through a booking CLI
An AI agent with no prior knowledge of the tooling planned and priced a Dulles–Barcelona round trip with seven hotel nights in under three minutes, verified bookable by dry run (vendor demo).
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
A fresh agent session got one instruction: plan and price a real trip with Voyagier's CLI. It read the tool's built-in docs, created one traveler with a passport and loyalty numbers, searched live flights and hotels, and chose a United nonstop and Le Méridien Barcelona. Each response listed remaining blockers and the next command. It finished with a dry-run booking check.
How it went
The cold agent reached a verified $3,931.21 quote in 26 commands and just under seven minutes. An agent that already knew the tool took 17 commands and 161 seconds. It still hit minor friction, such as a warning line that corrupted JSON output.
Worth knowing
Access is by invitation, and the real booking step spends money. Search, plan, quote and dry-run cost nothing, and the booking command refuses to run without a stated expected total.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
Plan a round trip from [home airport] to [destination city] leaving [start date] and returning [end date], with [number] hotel nights. Find flight and hotel options within a budget of [amount], and give me a single priced itinerary with links so I can check each part is bookable. Stop once you've presented the itinerary and total cost; do not book or enter payment details without showing me exactly what you're about to purchase and getting my approval.
Original source: https://www.voyagier.com/blog/voyagier-for-ai-agents
